question: How do these pinned Qwen3-0.6B artifacts behave across supported Apple phones and growing conversations?
unitOfReplication: a full conversation with its own fresh adapter and report, not an individual output token
deviceLimitations: The current catalog puts iPhone 8, 11 Pro and 14 Pro on iOS 16.6, below this harness's baseline iOS 17 and delegate iOS 18 minimums.
OS and lab environment differ. Hardware differences cannot be isolated as a sole cause.
Verify runtime availability and memory fit by smoke test on each device. Preserve unavailable cells instead of silently omitting them.

scenarios.purpose: retain original facts while history grows
retain original facts and replace stale values
cancel an auxiliary generation after three callbacks, reset, then recover the recorded conversation and probe facts

execution.blocks: Run one repetition per separate XCTest invocation or isolated report block. Record block index and source/build hashes.
execution.order: Rotate the fast runtime order by block index. Core ML runs alone in a separate invocation, with a 40-minute XCTest allowance and 45-minute Firebase limit.
execution.cache: Record primary retained-prefix or rebuild-each-turn requests. For prefix-enabled runtimes, also replay the identical recorded message arrays with a fresh conversation reset before each request.
execution.coldStart: Measure adapter load once per block. Label fresh process startup separately. Do not claim cold filesystem caches.
execution.thermal: Wait at most three minutes for nominal before each adapter load. Preserve non-nominal samples with flags and report nominal-only sensitivity analysis separately.
execution.failures: Checkpoint every request. Preserve download, load, generation, timeout, memory and thermal failures in the denominator. Retry as a new attempt with linkage, never overwrite.
execution.cloudBudget: Estimate each job before submission. Obtain approval for paid execution when required. Installation and result collection are excluded from Firebase execution billing.

analysis.shortAnswerThroughput: Report but flag answers under eight generated tokens as unstable throughput estimates.
analysis.quality: Facts and requested format are scored independently. Factual grading is unchanged from version 2. Format-only grading checks plain JSON with required keys, a single alphabetic diet word or an integer budget. The original combined exact-answer check is retained as strictProbeSuccess.
analysis.gradingAudit: Version 2 was clarified after the first local S3 harness-validation block and before expanded matrix execution. The initial analyzer treated a correct value with dietary-rule prefix as a factual miss. Preserve version-1 analysis and all original raw outputs. Version 3 corrects the format-only metric after local baseline replication. See Study/grading-v3.md. Version-2 analysis and the pre-addendum protocol are retained.

claimsExcluded: runtime-only superiority across differing quantization/export/template/cache policy
general conversational quality from synthetic recall
Neural Engine placement from Core ML allowed compute units
hardware-only causation across different OS/lab conditions
repeated-study conclusions from historical single-conversation pilots
deliverables: publication-ready report with methods and limitations
